# EcclesiaOS v1.0.41

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.41 improves Website Studio editing, member portal onboarding, navigation permissions, and public-site reliability.

## Website Studio

- Added mixed image and video hero slider support.
- Added editable column and sub-column backgrounds, colors, transparency, width, height, image, and video settings.
- Preserved column settings after saving and reloading sections.
- Added compact media removal controls and improved background/widget styling with consistent icons.
- Improved card shadow and public column background rendering.
- Hidden disabled reusable sections from public websites.

## Member portal onboarding

- Existing members can create a portal login linked to their existing member record.
- Members who select the returning-member path can still register when no legacy record matches.
- New contact details are retained for future matching without creating duplicate members.

## Navigation and reliability

- Submenus and mega menus now use correct light and dark theme backgrounds.
- Members no longer see Programs & Attendance when they lack event, attendance, or studio permissions.
- Fixed the root route and moved it to a cache-safe controller implementation.

## Verification

- Authentication, member registration, Website Studio, and module route tests passed.
- Git whitespace validation passed.
- The release workflow will build and publish the stable package when tag `v1.0.41` is pushed.
